title: Eldercare Medical Escort
titleZh: 老龄社会可信陪诊平台：行业深度调研与MVP
subtitle: Trustworthy outpatient companion services · Human-operated, privacy-first pilot
summary: Evidence-based research into eldercare medical escort services and a bounded single-city outpatient companion MVP. Includes safety, consent, dispatch, service recovery, compliance and unit-economics validation; no product or market traction claimed.
summaryZh: 基于政府数据、国内外陪诊实践与用户讨论的行业研究，配套单城常规门诊陪诊 PRD 和详细 MVP 规格；强调安全、老人授权、人工派单、售后及真实经营验证，产品未开发。
signal: China aging demographics + early municipal escort pilots; paid demand and profit require direct validation
problem: Adult children often cannot accompany older relatives to routine outpatient visits; a ride alone does not resolve hospital navigation, waiting, logistics, privacy and accurate communication.
thesis: A tightly scoped, verified and insured local companion service with explicit elderly consent, manual risk triage, reliable backup dispatch and opt-in family updates may outperform a generic nationwide marketplace. Hypothesis only.
findings: Official Chinese data show 60+ people account for 23.0% of the population in 2025; the population total is not the paid addressable market.
Shanghai Pudong has published prices and early operational volumes; these illustrate real service delivery but not nationwide profitability.
Hacker News and Reddit reveal logistical care-coordination and in-clinic accompaniment pain points; forum comments cannot quantify Chinese willingness to pay.
GB/T 47801—2026 raises service standard expectations without granting medical-practice authority; consent and family information sharing must be separate.
Pilot in one city with manual risk triage and 2–3 hospitals before investing in scale or AI automation.
risks: No original field interviews, direct competitor mystery shopping, paid user trials, independently verified retention or company financial data in the desk research.
Health information, vulnerable users, emergency response, hospital site rules, worker classification, insurance and local registration need specialist review.
Illustrative 298 CNY order economics are hypotheses; acquisition costs, total staff time and refunds can erase positive contribution.
The PRD and functional requirements are proposed documents; no deployed software, agency affiliation, medical qualification or healthcare result is claimed.
method: Public-source desk research: China NBS and government/regulatory documents, municipal pilot descriptions, HN/Reddit conversations, Product Hunt adjacent products and primary vendor documentation. Sources classified by evidence quality; 31 original citations in report. No field validation.
